visual.general_description: Color antibiotic-therapy timeline infographic from Feb 12 to June 18 with dated nodes and drug regimens.
visual.detailed_description: Horizontal cyan timeline arrow on a white background with eleven colored circular nodes, gray date boxes alternating above and below the line, and colored heading labels with small black text. Left to right: Feb 12 Diagnosis (Colorectal cancer+surgical resection); an undated green node labelled Multiple intestinal obstruction; May 26 Admission (Recurrent abdominal pain and bloating for over a month+urgent laparotomy); May 27 Deteriorate (Piperacillin/tazobactam 4.5g QD, exploratory laparotomy, Transferred to ICU); May 27 Postoperatively (Imipenem/cilastatin 1g Q8H+ vancomycin hydrochloride 1g Q12H); June 1 Consultation (Meropenem 1g Q8H+ vancomycin 1g Q12H); June 4 Pathogen culture (Enterococcus gallinarum (group D), Levofloxacin injection 0.3g QD+ meropenem 1g Q8H.); June 7 De-escalation (Levofloxacin 0.3g QD+ aztreonam 1g QD); June 9 Discharge from ICU (Aztreonam 1g QD); June 12 Antibiotic cessation; June 18 Discharge in a diamond-shaped terminal marker. No year, patient name or identifiers are printed.

caption_claims.value: Caption states the figure shows the patient's antibiotic therapy over the course of admission.

evidence.quote:
Figure 1.
Antibiotic therapy of the patient over the course of admission.

clinical_significance.statement: Authors present this as the antibiotic course of the index patient during admission, with culture-directed change after Enterococcus gallinarum isolation.

evidence.quote: During surgery, wound secretion cultures were also obtained, and the patient was transferred to the intensive care unit for postoperative monitoring and treatment (Fig. 1).
Antibiotic therapy was consequently adjusted based on sensitivity results to levofloxacin (300 mg once daily) combined with meropenem (1000 mg every 8 hours).

limitations: Printed dates carry no year. Figure dates (admission, ICU discharge, discharge, culture) and piperacillin/tazobactam are not given in the case text, which names imipenem-cilastatin plus vancomycin as the empiric regimen without mentioning piperacillin/tazobactam. Small text was legible at 2x magnification.

visual.general_description: Dual-axis line chart of daily leukocyte count and body temperature from 27-5 to 10-6.
visual.detailed_description: Dual-axis line chart on a white background with light gray dotted gridlines. The x-axis is titled "Date Day−Month)" with fifteen daily ticks from 27-5 to 10-6. The left blue y-axis is titled "Leukocyte Count /×10^9" (0 to 10); a blue line with star markers starts near 3.4 on 27-5, falls to about 2.5 on 29-5, stays near 3.4 on 30-5 and 31-5, jumps to about 7.6 on 1-6, rises gradually to about 9.75 on 8-6 and is about 8.25 on 10-6. The right red y-axis is titled "Temperature /℃" (36 to 40); a red line with open circle markers starts near 37.9 on 27-5, peaks near 39.1 on 28-5, is about 38.9 on 29-5, drops to about 37.0 on 30-5 and its minimum near 36.4 on 31-5, then fluctuates between about 36.6 and 37.6 through 10-6 (about 37.1). A legend at upper left names Leukocyte Count (blue) and Temperature (red). No patient identifiers, reference-range lines or annotations are printed. All plotted values are estimated from marker positions, not printed.
